presets.name: Cinematic Portrait Push-In
presets.description: Slow dolly push-in on a portrait or character with natural wind movement, subtle eye contact, and atmospheric ambient audio.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the reference subject. Keep the subject identity, outfit, and scene composition consistent. One continuous four-second cinematic shot with a smooth, slow dolly push-in toward the subject. Gentle breeze moves the hair and fabric naturally while the subject makes a calm, lifelike micro-expression and subtle head turn toward the lens. Natural depth of field, stable facial geometry, photorealistic lighting, no cuts, no text or watermarks. Audio: soft atmospheric wind and warm ambient room tone, no speech or copyrighted music.

presets.name: Dynamic Street Tracking Walk
presets.description: Smooth backward tracking camera following the subject walking forward through an urban street scene with natural stride and city ambience.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the reference character and setting. Keep the same face, hairstyle, and outfit. One continuous four-second medium tracking shot as the camera glides smoothly backward while the subject walks forward at a relaxed, confident pace. Natural arm swing, realistic coat and fabric motion, and softly shifting background bokeh lights. Stable anatomy, no camera cuts, no text or logos. Audio: subtle footsteps on pavement and gentle evening street ambience, no lyrics or recognizable song.

presets.name: Studio Product Orbit Reveal
presets.description: Smooth orbital macro camera glide around a product or object on a tabletop with shifting specular highlights and clean studio atmosphere.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the exact product and tabletop reference. Keep the object shape, material textures, and surface placement intact. One continuous four-second commercial macro shot as the camera performs a smooth, slow orbital arc around the object. Warm rim light and subtle reflections glide naturally across the surface while soft atmospheric mist drifts in the background. Crisp focus on the hero object, no morphing, no text overlays. Audio: clean, subtle studio atmosphere and gentle glass/surface resonance, no voiceover.
